overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating LLMs' ability to handle multiple-choice questions with no correct answers (reflective judgment). The main NLG outputs are the model responses to MCQs. Automatic evaluation uses custom metrics (RJ Score + Accuracy). Human evaluation was conducted with 50 participants comparing human vs. model performance on the same tasks. No LLM-as-judge evaluation was performed.
